BrochureContent.Content:
Home Club are delighted to present this very bright and spacious 3-bedroom semi-detached property to the market. Situated on the outskirts of the town in a small, quiet development, the property benefits from spacious living accommodation while remaining within walking distance of Athy Town. 

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, living room, open-plan kitchen and dining area and a downstairs w.c. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms with the master en-suite and main bathroom. There is off-street parking to the front of the property and a large garden to the rear. 

The property is located just off the new Athy Ring Road, and there are a host of services & amenities only minutes away, including shops, restaurants, cafes, leisure facilities, schools, etc. Commuting to Dublin is convenient via the M7 and M9, regular bus services, and the train station.

**Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate, and photographs provided for guidance only.
